fullPassage: Mental development consists of individuals increasingly mastering social codes and signals themselves, which they can master only in social situations with the support of more competent individuals, typically adults. In this sense, mental development consists of internalizing social patterns and gradually becoming a responsible actor among other responsible actors. In Denmark, the age of criminal responsibility is 15 years, which means that we then say that people have developed sufficient mental maturity to be accountable for their actions at this point. And at the age of 18 people are given the right to vote and are thereby formally included in the basic democratic process. I do not know whether these age boundaries are optimal, but it is clear that mental development takes place at different rates for different individuals, and depends especially on the social and family environment they have been given. Therefore, having formal limits for responsibility from a specific age that apply to everyone is a somewhat questionable practice. But the question, of course, is whether it can be done any differently.

❌ ④ 방향/장점은 각 문맥의 뜻이 아님

det.korean: 어떤 일을 성공적으로 해낼 능력·지식·기술을 갖춘 → competent(유능한)
det.analysis:
❌ ① mature(성숙한) — 나이·정신의 성숙이지 능력을 뜻하지 않음
❌ ② responsible(책임감 있는) — 책임을 지는 것이지 능력 자체는 아님
✅ ③ competent — '어떤 일을 잘 해낼 능력·기술을 갖춘'에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ formal(공식적인) — 격식·공식성을 뜻해 정의와 무관
det.tip: competent = 필요한 능력·기술을 갖춘, 유능한

questions.passage: In Denmark, the age of criminal responsibility is 15 years, which means that we then say that people have developed sufficient mental __________ (mature) to be accountable for their actions at this point.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: mature → maturity: 형용사 mature(성숙한)를 명사 maturity(성숙함)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: maturity — 'sufficient mental _____(충분한 정신적 ~)'에서 앞에 형용사 mental이 있으니 빈칸에는 명사가 와야 해요. 형용사 mature(성숙한)를 명사 maturity(성숙함)로 바꿔 'mental maturity(정신적 성숙)'가 돼요.
det.tip: mature(형용사) → maturity(명사). mental maturity = 정신적 성숙

questions.passage: Therefore, having formal limits for responsibility from a specific age that apply to everyone is a somewhat questionable practice. But the question, of course, is whether it can be done any __________ (different).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: different → differently: 형용사 different(다른)를 부사 differently(다르게)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: differently — 'it can be done any _____(그것이 ~하게 행해질 수 있다)'에서 빈칸은 동사 be done(행해지다)을 꾸며요. 동사를 꾸미는 자리에는 부사가 와야 하므로 형용사 different가 아니라 부사 differently(다르게)가 맞아요.
det.tip: different(형용사) → differently(부사). 동사를 꾸미면 부사

questions.passage: Mental development consists of individuals increasingly mastering social codes and signals themselves, which they can master only in social situations with the support of more competent individuals, typically adults. In this sense, mental development consists of internalizing social patterns and gradually becoming a responsible actor among other responsible actors. In Denmark, the age of criminal responsibility is 15 years, which means that we then say that people have developed sufficient mental maturity to be accountable for their actions at this point. And at the age of 18 people are given __________ and are thereby formally included in the basic democratic process. I do not know whether these age boundaries are optimal, but it is clear that mental development takes place at different rates for different individuals, and depends especially on the social and family environment they have been given. Therefore, having formal limits for responsibility from a specific age that apply to everyone is a somewhat questionable practice. But the question, of course, is whether it can be done any differently.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 18세에 '투표할 권리(the right to vote)'가 주어져 민주적 절차에 포함된다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① a criminal record(전과) — 민주 절차 편입 흐름과 무관
❌ ② the duty to work(근로 의무) — 투표·민주 절차와 무관
❌ ③ a formal warning(공식 경고) — 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ the right to vote — 원문 일치. 'people are given _____ and are thereby formally included in the basic democratic process'에서 '투표할 권리'가 적절 ←정답
det.tip: given the right to vote → 민주적 절차에 공식 편입

questions.passage: Mental development consists of individuals increasingly mastering social codes and signals themselves, which they can master only in social situations with the support of more competent individuals, typically adults. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정신적 발달은 '사회적 양식을 내면화하는 것(internalizing social patterns)'이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① rejecting old traditions(옛 전통을 거부하는 것) — 내면화 흐름과 반대
✅ ② internalizing social patterns — 원문 일치. 'consists of _____ and gradually becoming a responsible actor'에서 사회적 양식의 '내면화'가 적절 ←정답
❌ ③ avoiding every conflict(모든 갈등을 피하는 것) — 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ memorizing exact rules(정확한 규칙을 암기하는 것) — 내면화(체화)와 다른 개념
det.tip: consists of internalizing social patterns — 사회적 양식의 내면화
